---
name: Feedback
about: Tell us what worked or what didn't when you used WriteLikeHuman
title: "[feedback] "
labels: feedback
---

Thanks for taking a minute. Short answers are fine.

**Please don't paste personal files or real messages.** Use made-up text that shows the same problem. Change names, numbers, and addresses.

**Did it work?**
- [ ] This worked
- [ ] This didn't work

**What did you ask for?**
<!-- The words you typed, for example: "Make this email sound less robotic". If you attached a file, say what kind (Word, PDF, spreadsheet) but don't attach it. -->

**What did you expect?**
<!-- For example: "a shorter, friendlier email with the same dates". -->

**What happened?**
<!-- For example: "it changed the date", "it didn't use the skill", "it worked well". -->

**Where were you using Claude?**
- [ ] claude.ai in a browser
- [ ] Claude desktop app
- [ ] Claude phone app
- [ ] Claude Code

**Which version did you install?**
<!-- The release you downloaded, for example v0.3.2. You'll find it on the Releases page next to WriteLikeHuman.zip. -->

**Anything else?**
<!-- Optional. -->
